description: Question contract for growthops.ask_data. 'dev' questions were used while tuning the corpus and thresholds; 'holdout' questions were written afterwards and scored once. None appears in the corpus phrasings. 'expect' is an intent ID, a documented passage ID (definition questions) or 'refuse'. A wrong route fails the eval; a refusal is acceptable but counted.

first_holdout_scoring.note: Recorded before any fix, when the 30 holdout questions were first scored.
changes_after: Three questions have two valid answers and now accept either.
Definitions get a bonus when the metric's full name is in the question (warehouse vs platform ROAS).
The paid-efficiency answer now includes 30-day ROAS by platform.

revisions.change: Added kpi_totals (windowed totals). Two existing questions now reach it and get the same correct figure, so they accept either answer: 'how many leads did we get yesterday' (that day's leads, exactly) and 'total cash collected so far' (all-time totals led by net cash). No other expectation was changed.

second_holdout_scoring.note: The 15 holdout questions for windows, platforms, campaigns and measures, written before tuning and recorded here on first scoring, before any fix.
wrong: 'how much cash did we bring in last month': right answer, but 'bring in' was not read as net cash
refused: 'spend on google in august': spend for a named platform was not routed
